name: Paris
description: Boulevards, museums and long dinners — the classic first stop in Europe.

name: Rome
description: Two thousand years of ruins wrapped around great, cheap food.

name: Barcelona
description: Gaudí, beaches and tapas within one walkable grid.

name: Amsterdam
description: Canals, bikes and world-class galleries in a compact centre.

name: Prague
description: Storybook old town, and the best value city break in Europe.

name: Lisbon
description: Tiled hills, trams and Atlantic light on a modest budget.

name: Santorini
description: Caldera sunsets and whitewashed villages above the Aegean.

name: Reykjavik
description: Base camp for glaciers, geysers and the northern lights.

name: Interlaken
description: Two lakes, one valley, and the Alps in every direction.

name: Tokyo
description: Neon districts, quiet shrines and the best transit on earth.

name: Kyoto
description: Temples, bamboo and machiya streets — Japan at half speed.

name: Bali
description: Rice terraces, surf breaks and long stays for very little.

name: Bangkok
description: Street food, river temples and the cheapest big city in Asia.

name: Singapore
description: Hawker centres and skyline gardens, effortlessly easy to navigate.

name: Dubai
description: Desert dunes on one side, record-breaking towers on the other.

name: Jaipur
description: Pink City forts and bazaars — colour-saturated and very affordable.

name: Goa
description: Beach shacks, Portuguese churches and slow coastal days.

name: Hanoi
description: Old Quarter chaos, lake mornings and unbeatable street food.

name: New York
description: Everything, all at once — plan hard or the budget disappears.

name: San Francisco
description: Fog, hills and the gateway to Yosemite and the Pacific coast.

name: Vancouver
description: Mountains meeting the sea at the edge of the city.

name: Mexico City
description: Ancient pyramids, modern galleries and the best value on the continent.

name: Rio de Janeiro
description: Beaches wedged between granite peaks, alive at all hours.

name: Cusco
description: Andean base for the Sacred Valley and Machu Picchu.

name: Buenos Aires
description: European boulevards, Latin nights and remarkable steak.

name: Cape Town
description: Table Mountain, wine valleys and two oceans in one week.

name: Marrakech
description: Souks, riads and the Atlas Mountains an hour away.

name: Zanzibar City
description: Stone Town alleys opening onto white Indian Ocean sand.

name: Sydney
description: Harbour, surf beaches and coastal walks between them.

name: Queenstown
description: Adventure capital — bungee, hikes and alpine lakes.
